reference.limits: Not published on the pages opened. The site blocks direct requests (403 'CV-Library.co.uk - Blocked'); read through r.jina.ai. Partner Centre offers affiliates a real-time XML jobs feed on request (no self-serve docs); /recruiter/api is the recruiter client login (job-posting API for paying recruiters). User terms read via r.jina.ai contain no explicit bot / scraping clause in the extracted sentences (only credit / billing automation wording).

reason: No readable public API reference (re-checked 2026-09-25): https://www.cv-library.co.uk/partnercentre, /developers, /api and /partners now answer HTTP 403 to plain requests and a 'Blocked - You triggered a security action' page to headless Chromium, so nothing beyond the earlier reading can be confirmed. That earlier reading of the Partner Centre described a Traffic Partner programme whose only data product is an 'XML live jobs feed' supplied to signed-up affiliates ('We can supply you this in XML format') with no published URL, parameters or schema, onboarded by the Partner Manager. The official GitHub org (github.com/cv-library) holds only Docker/infrastructure repositories, no API client or spec.
